method: Five-minute application workload (297.35 seconds receiver capture) at 2 MSPS with API polling, selected-target WebSockets and a browser showing the live gauge on office Wi-Fi. Initial ephemeral target replaced with Xiaomi target for stable timing.

health.source_continuity: UNVERIFIED: no source sample counter in IQ stream

limitations: RTT measured from development computer, not Android and not RF-to-screen delay.
Source continuity lacks hardware sample counter.
Five minutes does not qualify every field workload.
Selected Xiaomi target produced approximately one decoded observation every two seconds.
final_state: Scan stopped and diagnostic target cleared; board connected to TDCOMM with no pending network rollback.
